workload.log_state: prefix digest computed, one valid event appended, then the original prefix digest queried
workload.comparison: cached digest and next-sequence lookup versus the previous separate full digest and max-sequence scans

limitations: This isolates EventLog prefix digest lookup and does not measure segment file I/O, serialization, or end-to-end pipeline/backtest speed.

Appending an EventLog automatically caches the prefix at the pre-append length; same-instance and cloned logs can reuse that summary while it remains in the eight-entry cache. Cache eviction and prefixes that were never captured still require a scan.
The digest format and event serialization are unchanged.
Synthetic event counts do not represent the nine product profiles or production data quality.
